ingredients.name: SunOne J™ Filters
ingredients.shortDesc:
New-gen filters that provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA & UVB rays.
These modern filters are designed for high photostability.
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- A blend of next-generation UV filters that protect against both UVA (aging rays) and UVB (burning rays).

- Provides broad-spectrum SPF 50+ protection from daily sun exposure

- Highly photostable filters, meaning they remain effective even under prolonged sunlight

- Designed to provide high protection with a lightweight, non-greasy feel

Key Filters in the Formula

1. Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate (Uvinul A Plus)

Advanced UVA filter that protects against long-wave UVA rays responsible for premature skin aging and pigmentation.

2. Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine (Tinosorb S)

Broad-spectrum filter that protects against both UVA and UVB rays while stabilizing other UV filters in the formula.

3. Ethylhexyl Triazone (Uvinul T150)

One of the most efficient UVB filters, helping prevent sunburn and tanning caused by UVB radiation.

4. Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol (Tinosorb M)

Hybrid filter that protects against both UVA and UVB rays, offering long-lasting sun protection.

These filters work together to provide high sun protection while maintaining a lightweight lotion texture suitable for daily body use.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.shortDesc: A multi-benefit vitamin that helps reduce tanning and uneven skin tone, while strengthening the skin barrier and improving overall skin clarity.
ingredients.longDesc:
- A form of Vitamin B3 known for its skin-brightening and barrier-strengthening benefits

- Helps reduce the appearance of tanning and uneven skin tone

- Supports skin barrier repair and improves moisture retention

- Helps improve overall skin clarity and texture

Niacinamide works by regulating melanin transfer within the skin, which helps gradually reduce the appearance of pigmentation and tanning. With regular use, it can help skin look more even-toned and healthier.

Research also suggests that niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier, which improves hydration and reduces environmental damage.

ingredients.name: Guava Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: A vitamin-rich fruit extract known for its antioxidant properties, helping support more even-looking skin and reducing the appearance of sun-induced dullness.
ingredients.longDesc:
- Rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants

- Helps support skin brightening and even skin tone

- Helps protect skin from environmental stress and sun-induced dullness

- Supports healthier-looking skin texture

Guava extract contains high levels of antioxidants and vitamin C, which help neutralize free radicals generated by sun exposure. This helps reduce the appearance of dull, uneven skin tone caused by tanning and environmental stress.

It also supports skin renewal, helping reveal smoother and fresher looking skin over time.

ingredients.name: Papaya Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: A natural fruit enzyme extract that helps gently exfoliate dead skin cells, improving skin clarity and reducing the appearance of tanning.
ingredients.longDesc:
- Contains natural enzymes like papain

- Helps gently exfoliate dead skin cells

- Supports brighter and smoother skin

- Helps improve the appearance of sun-induced tanning

Papaya extract contains papain enzymes, which help break down dead skin cells on the surface of the skin. This gentle exfoliation helps reveal fresher, smoother and more even-looking skin.

Regular use helps improve skin clarity and reduce the appearance of sun-induced dullness and tanning.

ingredients.name: Pomegranate Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: A powerful antioxidant-rich extract that helps protect skin from sun-induced damage and supports brighter, healthier-looking skin.
ingredients.longDesc:
- Rich in polyphenols and antioxidants

- Helps protect skin from free radical damage caused by UV exposure

- Supports skin renewal and healthier-looking skin

- Helps improve the appearance of dull and uneven skin tone

Pomegranate extract is known for its high concentration of antioxidants such as ellagic acid and polyphenols, which help protect skin from oxidative stress caused by sun exposure.

These antioxidants support skin repair and renewal, helping improve overall skin appearance and reduce dullness caused by environmental damage.

description:
Meet the Be Bodywise De-Tan SPF 50+ Body Sunscreen Lotion: Corrects tan, protects from UV & hydrates skin.

Ultralight. Non-sticky.

🌞 Why you’ll love it:

⭐ Tested Sun Protection
SPF validated through In-Vivo & In-Vitro testing.

⭐ Helps Reduce Tan
Niacinamide + fruit extracts support visible tan correction.

⭐ SPF 50+ Broad Spectrum Protection

Advanced SunOne J UV filters protect against UVA & UVB rays.

faqs.question: Is this sunscreen suitable for daily use?
faqs.answer: Yes. The ultralight formula makes it comfortable for everyday use on arms, legs, and other exposed areas.

faqs.question: Does this sunscreen leave a white cast?
faqs.answer: No. The lotion absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a white residue.

faqs.question: Can this sunscreen help with tanning?
faqs.answer: The formula contains Niacinamide and antioxidant fruit extracts that help reduce the appearance of tanning with regular use.

faqs.question: How often should I reapply this sunscreen?
faqs.answer: Reapply every 2-3 hours when exposed to sunlight for optimal protection.

faqs.question: Can this sunscreen be used on the face?
faqs.answer: This sunscreen is recommended only for the body. For facial use, you can try our Ultralight Sunscreen SPF 50+
